name: New articles get indexed
goal: A new blog article or language edition goes live on virev.ai about every day and answers 200, Google indexes each one within 3 days, IndexNow gets every new or changed blog URL, and every ledger check is scored on its date so we learn which articles earned search traffic.

metrics.label: Days since a new blog article or edition went live and returned 200
Articles live 3 or more days that Google has not indexed
Blog sitemap URLs IndexNow has not got in their current version
Ledger checks past their check date with no result
Ledger checks scored in the last 30 days that won
Data sources that failed (sitemap, pages, Search Console, ledger)

onMiss: Work in auto-sns-agent, program folder apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/02/0040-virev-seo-agent/program. Fix a source_error first. No new article: find the land or CI run that holds the next built article and move it on a fresh ci/ branch (board s22); if none is in the pipeline, spawn the next one from p37's opportunities.md, one subagent per article. Unindexed: run the recrawl worker (workers/seo-recrawl/README.md) on sc-domain:virev.ai until Quota Exceeded. indexnow_unsent: run `uv run --project scripts/seo seo indexnow --new`. Overdue ledger check: score it with numbers; a loss gets a dated line in decisions.md (rewrite, merge or stop that topic). Staging lands are fine (c50); ask before a prod promote. No merge without the owner's go (c49) and nothing outside without his ok on a For you todo (c37). Do this on every run, met or missed, and tell the owner only what shipped or what needs him.
